name: OpenVDB (VDB)
aliases: Volumetric, Dynamic grid that shares several characteristics with B+trees
definition: A sparse voxel representation used for hierarchical encoding and compression of volumetric grids, featuring fast O(1) random access on modification and retrieval operations.
summary: OpenVDB is a sparse voxel format using a four-level tree and bitmasks to efficiently store and access large volumetric datasets with empty regions, serving as the industry standard for visual effects.
